title: Installation and runtime checks
label: Runtime checks
checked: The built extension loads and runs under the PHP CLI and PHP-FPM, keeps the API of the latest release, and holds less than half of a CSV file in memory when a streaming scan keeps few rows.
description: tests/deployment.php checks the extension version, a group_by result, and the thread pool size; scripts/check-fpm sends it to a php-fpm worker as a FastCGI request. scripts/api-compat.php reads the latest release tag's stubs. tests/memory.php writes a CSV and runs each filter in its own PHP process, comparing their peak resident set sizes. scripts/check runs these checks before a release, and CI runs it on Ubuntu 24.04 and macOS 15 with PHP 8.3, 8.4, and 8.5.

comparison.applies_to: each check passes or fails as its script exits

cases.name: PHP CLI
cases.quantity: version matches Cargo.toml, a group_by result, and the thread pool size

cases.name: PHP-FPM
cases.quantity: the same assertions through a FastCGI request to a php-fpm worker
cases.reason: php-fpm or cgi-fcgi is not installed on the machine that made this record; CI runs this check in the packaging workflow.

cases.name: API compatibility with v0.2.1
cases.quantity: 948 functions and methods of v0.2.1 still exist, with its parameters as a prefix of today's

cases.name: Streaming filter memory
cases.quantity: peak RSS added by a streaming filter that keeps 4% of a 93 MB CSV: 31 MB, against a limit of half the file
